verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents a way to opt out of Raygun's own telemetry or usage tracking, whether of its SDKs, dashboard, or AI features. The cited privacy controls are adjacent features: they cover the customer's captured error data, not opting out of tracking. These are filtering sensitive fields before sending and the 'Disable IP address storage' flag.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
